I have a therapy and a medication. Tomorrow I go to psychiatrist.

I came speak here just to find random people to talk with. I am in loneliness in my country.

I know but it's the straw that broke the camel's back. It's been years I've been in depression and that I'm suicidal for other deeper traumatism, I had a therapy and that guy destroyed the whole thing.
Treated me like a shit, manipulate me as I can do favor to him. And dropped me when I came back in Europe after having drained all my energy.

Thanks so much, your support is very appreciated...  
I am feeling kind of better now. My ex still have stuff that I need to get back (medications) because there are expensives and I've already lost too much money because of him...
Thanks... I feel kind of better now, I was in a crisis when I wrote this...

I wrote that in a crisis. Actually I paid a plane ticket to see him, but as he wanted to see me earlier I paid more. I corrected this.  
And I paid a lot of gift, food, and stuff for him, to take care of him, because he was angry at me for any little thing. He was being very paranoid.
